body:
Xtra can't respond to this thread at the moment. Here is his message:

"Hello Ryan, there are rules in the teamspeak channel you were in at the time. Music Room #1 rules are: Please be respectful and enjoy! Allow other players to play every once in a while. If you troll, annoy players, or dont allow other players to enjoy some of their own music, then you will be tempbanned. Explicit music is allowed unless it involves offensive material. It is up to the staff member to determine whether or not the song is appropriate. Bans may be issued. You were punished under "Annoying players" as you were making inappropriate sounds in the channel which was in fact annoying a player."
p, li { white-space: pre-wrap; }


so u mention that i was ANNOYING a player but how am i supposed to know if they're being annoyed? rilo just stayed silent and didn't say anything? 


HELLO I WANT THIS ESCALATED
